description: This file defines the `RecommendationRepository` class, which handles database operations related to recommendations, including creating recommendations and listing them with or without job details, tailored for a specific analysis.

classes.name: RecommendationRepository
classes.description: A repository class for performing CRUD operations related to recommendations in the database.

methods.name: int create(self, analysis_id: UUID, job_id: int, score: float)
methods.description: Inserts a new recommendation record linking an analysis and a job with a score, returning the inserted record's ID.

methods.name: List[dict] list_by_analysis(self, analysis_id: UUID)
methods.description: Retrieves all recommendations for a specific analysis, ordered by score descending.

methods.name: List[dict] list_by_analysis_with_jobs( self, analysis_id: UUID, limit: int, offset: int )
methods.description: Retrieves recommendations for a specific analysis along with associated job details, ordered by score DESC, with pagination support.

ctags.name: create
ctags.pattern: /^    async def create(self, analysis_id: UUID, job_id: int, score: float) -> int:$/
ctags.signature: (self, analysis_id: UUID, job_id: int, score: float)

ctags.name: list_by_analysis
ctags.pattern: /^    async def list_by_analysis(self, analysis_id: UUID) -> List[dict]:$/

ctags.name: list_by_analysis_with_jobs
ctags.signature: ( self, analysis_id: UUID, limit: int, offset: int )
